derivation: Contract: the broad-extended-v4 design contract, sections 4, 5 and 7, with the decisions recorded in its section 10.

GOT calls and indirect sites: expected-got.json (7 blr, 3 attributed to ___chkstk_darwin, 4 declined) and expected-indirect-target.json (8 indirect instruction sites).

No AIRS engine, CLI or recover_swift_broad_flow was run and no engine output was read.

open_questions.topic: GOT-only symbol in the section 7 totals
open_questions.question: Section 7 gives 29 stubs and 54 stub calls. Section 4.8 and C2 count every attributed imported symbol, and the existing GOT expectation attributes 3 blr sites to ___chkstk_darwin, which has no stub. This file therefore expects 30 distinct symbols, 57 attributed calls, 30 not-Swift calls and non_swift_import 30. Please confirm the contract wants GOT-attributed non-Swift calls in the table and in non_swift_import, as C4 and C5 imply, and reconcile the section 7 prose.
open_questions.resolution: Decided (contract section 10, item 8): 30 entries, 57 attributed calls, non_swift_import 30.

open_questions.topic: compact declaration of a static accessor
open_questions.question: Reading the grammar source (not its output), a symbol ending in the static suffix Z with an accessor entity (CommandLine.arguments, String.Encoding.utf8) is declined with reason accessor and no identity, because the Z handler replaces the identity with an annotation. Contract 5.3 says a record without an identity has a reason other than accessor or typed_throws, so those two rows would fail the native consistency check. The non-static accessors (CodingKey description, debugDescription) do carry an identity with entity Getter. By hand from the specification alone this cannot be settled: the expectation records both branches for the two static accessors. Decision needed: either the grammar returns an identity for static accessors, or 5.3 allows a missing identity with reason accessor.
open_questions.recorded_as: both branches; decision, reason and licence class are not affected
open_questions.resolution: Decided (contract section 10, item 7): a static accessor is declined as accessor with no identity; the five identity fields are null.

open_questions.question: The 64-hex digest of each canonical identity JSON cannot be derived by hand without re-implementing the grammar identity serialiser, which would not be independent. It is not recorded. Row-level D1 sameness and the digest are left to the engine test, which can check that rows of one symbol share a digest and that a digest is 64 lowercase hex.
